phase3_findings.description: AC9 unmet: docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md:353 still describes the retired §1.4 Resume pre-check seam, calls the PR-body [View run] refresh cloud-only/inside the claude job, and documents the 'stale until next resume' accepted coverage boundary. All three are now factually false because this change makes the gate job the single owner of the link refresh, and the file is not modified in the diff (confirmed via --stat and direct grep). AC9 explicitly required this statement to describe the gate-job seam with no stale-link window.

Coupled-mirror drift: skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md:299 still describes GITHUB_RUN_ID/GITHUB_SERVER_URL/GITHUB_REPOSITORY as 'for the PR-body run-link refresh', but the mirror in agents/branch-setup.md was correctly updated to state that refresh is retired (gate owns it, vars not used for a link rewrite). The two dispatch-input descriptions are a coupled pair; the phase-1-setup site was left stating the now-false purpose. Shipped agent prose, verified stale on disk.

scripts/refresh-pr-on-resume.sh: if sourcing ../lib/resolve-gh.sh fails (partial deployment: scripts/ without lib/), the helper only warns; devflow_resolve_gh is then undefined and DEVFLOW_GH resolves empty, so downstream gh calls fail and surface as a generic REFUSED read/resolve rather than naming the real partial-deploy cause. Degrades fail-closed (no blanking), best-effort path, breadcrumbed — low impact.

refresh-pr-on-resume.sh REFRESHED-arm test (lib/test/run.sh ~5560) drives a PR body with no note block, so the helper's pr-note-block.py strip stage is never exercised end-to-end on a body that actually contains a note; and the PATCH stub does cat >/dev/null so the transformed body reaching the PATCH is never asserted. A regression PATCHing a wrong/blanked body while still emitting REFRESHED would pass. The strip transform is covered standalone.

The note-block coupling test pins only the marker literals byte-identical between pr-note-block.py and workpad.py, but the docstrings claim the transform LOGIC (_strip/_add) is a byte-identical parallel copy; a divergence in the transform bodies (not markers) is not caught by the pin, relying on each copy's separate behavioral tests.

scripts/workpad.py _stopped_note_text_for_mirror docstring opens 'Exactly three stop statuses write the block' but enumerates two statuses (Failed, Cancelled) plus one reflection-kind (blocked); 'statuses' is imprecise since one of the three is a reflection-kind. Logic and tests are correct; wording only.

diff_profile: code+tests+workflow+prompt+docs-changeset; 14 files, +768/-26; new helpers scripts/pr-note-block.py, scripts/resolve-issue-pr.py, scripts/refresh-pr-on-resume.sh; workpad.py mirror; devflow-implement.yml gate adopt arm; agents/branch-setup.md; skills/pr-description/SKILL.md; skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md; lib/test/run.sh (issue #2060 test block). NOT touched: docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md (AC9 target).
report: BLINDED SHADOW review of PR 2063 (issue #2060), engine skills/review Phases 0-4.3 (4.4 skipped, no GitHub post). Root SKILL.md read to EOF (line 342) — complete. All 5 expected Phase 3 reviewers dispatched blinded from fresh context and all 5 returned real assessments (type-design-analyzer correctly gated out — no new types); coverage=full. The implementation code is well-built: fail-closed idempotent transforms, best-effort absorbers placed AFTER the workpad PATCH so a mirror failure cannot alter the terminal recording, {owner}/{repo} REST paths, resolver-routed gh, and -->/marker sanitization on add. ACs 1-8 are satisfied by the code and tests. VERDICT: REJECT on AC9 — an explicit acceptance criterion requiring the run-link-refresh statement in docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md to describe the gate-job seam and drop the stale-link window. That file is not modified in the diff; line 353 still asserts the retired §1.4 pre-check seam, cloud-only refresh, and the 'stale until next resume' coverage boundary — all now factually wrong against the shipped gate-owned behavior. Corroborated independently by code-reviewer and the final-pass reviewer, and verified directly on disk. A coupled-mirror drift (phase-1-setup.md:299) compounds the Important tier. Remaining findings are Minor/Suggestion polish (masked source-failure cause, an orchestrated-strip test gap, coupling pin scoped to markers not transform logic, a docstring wording nit). Fixing line 353 (and the phase-1-setup coupled mirror) makes this mergeable.
